payload.summary: Release one exact reviewed npm artifact through ordered local and CI-equivalent gates, then publish only those reviewed tarball bytes after explicit maintainer approval.
gates: Use a fresh isolated writable npm cache; run frozen install, generated-version check, typecheck, full tests, lint, benchmark check, build, and require a clean source diff before packaging.

Create one retained candidate tarball; run source packaging once, then supplied-tarball package validation, v0.2 upgrade/downgrade compatibility, publish dry run, and built CLI validation against the same repository-relative tarball path.
Record byte size, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and npm integrity; require reviewed/main CI artifact byte identity before publication.
payload.publication: Publication is a manual tarball-only action: npm publish <reviewed-candidate.tgz>. Never rebuild or publish a directory, and never upload without the maintainer final explicit approval after merge and green main.

searchText: npm release exact reviewed tarball compatibility oracle upgrade downgrade isolated cache dry run explicit approval
subject: release.npm-exact-artifact
